lessons.lesson: A sales channel was opened before its standing grant existed; a GO with a 48h apply-by lapsed while waiting on owner permission (13513659). Rule now: grant-before-channel (Constitution Art.10; SITE_GRANTS + test) and <48h-deadline owner asks are escalated in the same fire. PG-2 granted 10/11.

The owner's login window (crowdworks-profile-relogin) was released blocked_by its own completion marker (owner-crowdworks-relogin-profile), so after one overnight miss no window would ever re-open and a 2nd GO (13513520) lapsed. A task that PROVIDES a human step must never be blocked_by that step's completion. Rule now: owner-enabling window tasks are time-guarded and self-re-arming (re-open, do not re-block), and a <48h-deadline owner login window is verified claimable every fire, not just escalated once.
